units.source_text: 船行渐近川尻地方，诸人方始透一口气。

en.t: As the boat gradually approached the Kawajiri area, everyone at last breathed a sigh of relief.

units.source_text: 那舟子照例粗声粗气地唱起船歌来：“唐泊开出船，三天到川尻。……”

en.t: The boatman, as usual, began singing a boat song in his rough voice: "A boat sets out from Karadomari, and in three days reaches Kawajiri..."

units.source_text: 丰后介用悲哀而温柔的声音唱着歌谣：“娇妻与爱子，我今都忘却。……”

en.t: Bungo no Suke sang in a sorrowful yet gentle voice: "My beloved wife and child, I now have forgotten them all..."

units.source_text: 思想起来，自己确是舍弃了妻与子，不知他们近况如何。

en.t: When he thought about it, he truly had abandoned his wife and child, and he did not know how they were now.

units.source_text: 家中干练可靠的仆人，都被他带走了。

en.t: He had taken away all the capable and dependable servants from the household.

units.source_text: 如果大夫监痛恨他，把他的妻子驱逐出境，他们将多么受苦！

en.t: If the Taifu no Gen hated him and drove his wife out of the province, how terribly they would suffer!

units.source_text: 此次之事，确是任情而动，不顾一切地仓皇逃出。

en.t: In this affair, he had indeed acted on impulse and fled in panic, heedless of everything.

units.source_text: 现在略略安定之后，回思可能发生的种种祸事，不觉心情颓丧，哭泣起来。

en.t: Now that he had settled down a little, he thought back on all the disasters that might occur, and without realizing it his spirits sank and he began to weep.

units.source_text: 随后又诵白居易诗句：“凉原乡井不得见，胡地妻儿虚弃捐。”

en.t: Then he recited lines from Bai Juyi: "I cannot see my native village of Liangyuan; in a barbarian land, I have vainly abandoned my wife and children."

units.source_text: 兵部君听见了，也回想起种种事情来：“此次之事，的确奇离古怪。

en.t: Hyobukyo heard this and also began recalling many things: "This whole affair is truly strange and extraordinary.

units.source_text: 我不惜多年相伴的丈夫的爱情，突然舍弃了他，逃往远方，不知他现在作何感想。”

en.t: I did not even cherish the love of the husband who had been with me for so many years, but suddenly abandoned him and fled far away; I wonder what he thinks now."

units.source_text: 又想：“我现在虽然是返乡，但在京并无可归之旧家，又无可亲之故人。

en.t: She thought further: "Although I am now returning to my homeland, in the capital I have no old home to return to and no dear old friends.

units.source_text: 只为了小姐一人之故，抛弃了这多年住惯的地方，飘泊于惊风骇浪之中。

en.t: Only for the sake of this young lady have I abandoned the place where I lived for so many years and drifted amid terrifying winds and waves.

units.source_text: 为何如此，百思不得其解。

en.t: Why it has come to this, I cannot understand no matter how much I think.

units.source_text: 总之，首先要安顿了这位小姐再说。”

en.t: In any case, first I must see this young lady settled, and then think of the rest."

units.source_text: 她茫然不知所措，匆匆地到达了京都。

en.t: Bewildered and at a loss, she hurriedly arrived in Kyoto.
